questions.text: IPPB is used to deliver short-duration lung expansion therapy, also called:
Which finding is listed as an indication for IPPB?

answers.text: Evidence of atelectasis on chest X-ray
Use of a passive HME during transport

questions.text: IPPB should be used only as a last resort because:

answers.text: It has not shown benefit greater than other lung expansion techniques
It is the only treatment for all atelectasis

questions.text: Which condition is an IPPB contraindication from the source?

The mechanical effects of IPPB last approximately:

During IPPB setup with a mouthpiece, the patient must:

answers.text: Seal the lips around the mouthpiece
Exhale into a dry powder inhaler
Keep the mask loose over the mouth

questions.text: Inspiratory sensitivity determines:

answers.text: The effort required to trigger the machine breath
The water vapor held by warm gas
The amount of medication left in an MDI

questions.text: The initial peak inspiratory pressure for IPPB is:

answers.text: More time to reach peak pressure
Less time to reach peak pressure

questions.text: Incentive spirometry facilitates SMI using:

answers.text: A metal ball vibrating in a pipe-shaped PEP device
A dose counter on an inhaler

questions.text: SMI is a slow, deep inspiration from FRC to TLC followed by:

answers.text: A breath hold of at least 5 seconds
Immediate forceful exhalation into an MDI

questions.text: Which patient is listed as an incentive spirometry candidate?

answers.text: Postoperative thoracic or abdominal surgical patient
Patient unable to understand the maneuver

questions.text: IS is contraindicated when the patient is:

answers.text: Uncooperative or unable to understand and perform the maneuver

questions.text: Before IS, the source says to position the patient in high Fowler's or:
During IS instruction, inspiratory time should be coached for:
Between IS breaths, the patient should be encouraged to:

answers.text: Cough forcefully to mobilize and expel secretions
